integrity: The statement is proved by exact Fourier aliasing and an elementary integer-lattice optimization. The standalone checker supplies finite corroboration, not an infinite certificate. Historical priority is conditional on accessible literature.
scientific_limitations: Optimization is restricted to at least two equally weighted parallel primitive closed geodesics. The cost is their total arclength, not connectivity or relocation. Nonparallel and arbitrary curved paths are not classified.
title: The sharp parallel-geodesic Parseval trajectory frontier on the flat two-torus
